test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ABSENCE' is written as 'DWVZQXH' and 'SERVICE is written as 'VZUQLXH. How will 'CONSENT' be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern/logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6b07fd0557c31540782a37b7252c5fb9387bfc2d7d3dd19f34eea3a5f0b7f9c.png] 

According to the alphabetical positions of the letters,

'ABSENCE' is written as 'DWVZQXH' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c50b382f3ddfb5c9ce7886920efb5509d6cbbf361278b794224fa03c76c9b6ce.png] 

And,

'SERVICE' is written as 'VZUQLXH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/729fcf9b643bc0be16aa098e9dab2abccd6a776c12101271af78b219f983cb95.png] 

Similarly,

'CONSENT' is written as 'FJQNHIW'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95808068ec14806824ee5a6689bcfd721a6d345417620e2ae240cd5e9e919275.png] 

Hence, ‘FJQNHIW’ is the correct answer.
